messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Definitions potentially useful to relate Stan output to frequentists properties of models
parts:
This is probably not the best place to discuss relations
between frequentist and Bayesian stats that isn't Stan specific.

Stan's samplers let you sample from any distribution for
which you can write the log probability function. So you
can use that for some types of frequentist analysis.

Stan also lets you derive frequentist estimates using
optimization (MLE or penalized MLE). But we don't have
any hypothesis testing or confidence interval estimation
in place for the estimates.

- Bob
